name: PR / Reputation Crisis
description: Reputation management response structure. Activates when negative media attention, public controversy, or social media firestorm threatens organizational reputation. Time-sensitive — response within 1 hour of detection.
trigger_conditions: Negative story published in major media outlet about the organization
Viral social media backlash (#cancel culture, boycott calls, employee misconduct video)
Executive misconduct allegation (harassment, fraud, ethics violation)
Product safety or quality issue receiving public attention
Customer data incident with public awareness (even before confirmation)
Offensive or insensitive content published by organization or on its platforms
Regulatory action or investigation reported in press
Partner or supplier controversy that reflects on the organization

responsibilities: Overall crisis command and strategic direction
Approve all external statements and positioning
Decide spokesperson assignments
Liaise with CEO and board on reputation strategy
Determine whether to proactively engage press or let story cycle pass
Authorize paid media, earned media, and owned media responses

ops_lead.role: Communications Director / Head of Corporate Communications
responsibilities: Media monitoring — track story across all outlets and social platforms
Statement drafting and rapid iteration with legal review
Spokesperson preparation including Q&A documents
Manage press inquiries queue and response tracking
Coordinate media training for executives before interviews
Run rapid-response war room
Media relationship management — contact editors and journalists directly
Press release distribution and media list management
Social media content strategy and posting cadence
Analyst and influencer outreach for third-party validation
Internal communications alignment so staff hears from org first, not from press
Coordinate with investor relations if public company
Statement legal review — liability assessment, admissions, confidentiality
Advise on legal risk of proactive vs. reactive communications
Coordinate with external counsel if litigation is anticipated
Ensure regulatory disclosure obligations are met (SEC, etc.)
Employee communication legal guardrails (no retaliation, confidentiality)

key_actions: 1. Confirm facts within 1 hour — what happened, when, who is involved, what is known vs. unknown
2. Draft initial holding statement acknowledging awareness without accepting liability
3. Never say 'no comment' — use 'We are gathering the facts and will share more as soon as possible'
4. Place social media hold on all scheduled posts — review and pause all organic and paid campaigns
5. Activate media monitoring — set up keyword alerts, social listening dashboards
6. Brief CEO and board within 2 hours with situation assessment and response plan
7. Prepare FAQ document — anticipate every question from press, customers, employees, investors
8. Identify and brief designated spokesperson(s) — limit to 1-2 trained individuals
9. Target external stakeholders: customers (email), partners (direct outreach), investors (call)
10. Plan for 24-hour news cycle escalation — prepare updated statements for each development
11. Monitor employee sentiment on internal channels — address misinformation internally first
12. Post-crisis reputation audit within 30 days — trust recovery metrics, media sentiment analysis

communication_protocol.internal: CEO sends all-staff email within 2 hours of crisis activation — informs before press does. Ops Lead sends daily internal Q&A updates. Department heads cascade to teams. All employee social media guidance issued immediately.
communication_protocol.external: Single designated spokesperson only. All statements approved by Comms Lead + Legal Lead before release. No off-the-record briefings without explicit approval. Press inquiries logged and responded to within 2 hours. Never speculate — if unknown, say 'we are investigating.'
communication_protocol.cadence: War room standup every 1 hour during first 8 hours. Every 2 hours for remainder of first 48 hours. Standup daily until story cycle demonstrably declines.

escalation_timeline.t0_1hr: Detect → Confirm facts → Activate crisis command → Place social media hold → Draft holding statement
escalation_timeline.t1_4hr: Brief CEO/board → Deploy holding statement → Activate media monitoring → Brief spokesperson → Begin stakeholder outreach
escalation_timeline.t4_24hr: Full Q&A prepared → First customer communication sent → Internal town hall if warranted → Respond to incoming press inquiries
escalation_timeline.t24_72hr: Analyze media sentiment → Adjust strategy → Second-wave statements if needed → Analyst and influencer outreach
escalation_timeline.t72hr_1wk: Monitor for story resurgence → Begin reputation repair → Relationship management with key media → Post-crisis assessment
